info.name: Realtor.com Property Data Agents Locations API

params.name: input
params.description: Partial location string for auto-completion. Can be a city name, zip code, address, or neighborhood name.

items.docs: Returns location suggestions based on a partial input string. Use this endpoint to help users find specific addresses, cities, zip codes, neighborhoods, or schools by providing type-ahead search functionality. The returned location identifiers can be used as inputs for property search endpoints.
